svg.metadata: {"story":"Noah","act":2,"chapter":"Ch.2 · The Blueprint","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty wide, and thirty high, with a roof, a door, and three decks.
